query_suffix: Return exactly one grasp pose and no prose. Two valid format examples are: <grasp pose> (512, 384), 0.0 </grasp pose> and <grasp pose> (256, 640), 90.0 </grasp pose>. These angles are only formatting examples: estimate theta from the shown object's orientation instead of copying either example. Use normalized x,y in [0,1000] and one scalar theta in degrees.
